capture_design.frame_elapsed_scope: Host-side wall interval through frame_post_draw; reported as a diagnostic, not a GPU benchmark.
capture_design.macro_crop_policy: All detail views declare expected_crop=true; model bounds and visible-mesh crop result remain in each capture record.
capture_design.maintenance_transform_policy: Only MeshInstance3D.visible changes; component transforms and their actual model positions are left untouched and mesh visibility is restored before each capture.
